name: hcc
description: HCC computational core: 133 laboratories behind one contract (describe · run · sweep · validate · export · cancel), 19 of them with a computational kernel. No browser, no WebGL, no animation frame.

legacy.note: plain POST {tool, arguments}; superseded by JSON-RPC 2.0 at /mcp and kept working for clients that already depend on it

tools.name: list_labs
tools.description: Enumerate every laboratory with its id, title, status and cost hint.

tools.name: describe_lab
tools.description: Full contract of one laboratory: inputs with units and domains, outputs, assumptions, domain of validity, falsifiers, verifiers and open problems.

tools.name: run_lab
tools.description: Run one laboratory and return the full 28-field provenance envelope. Out-of-domain inputs are REFUSED, never clamped.

tools.name: sweep_lab
tools.description: Run one laboratory over an array of values of a single named parameter. Each row reports its own success or refusal; a refused point does not abort the sweep.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: State, progress and result of an asynchronous run.

tools.name: cancel_run
tools.description: Cancel an asynchronous run; the worker thread is terminated.

tools.name: validate_run
tools.description: Execute a laboratory's own falsifiable self-tests and report each one.

tools.name: export_artifact
tools.description: Serialise a result envelope as json or csv.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: How laboratories connect, in the four forms this atlas has. TYPED: 336 hand-written edges over 113 laboratories, each with the KIND of relationship (exact, invariant, representation, coupling, limit, causal, analogy, contrast), the claim somebody wrote, and its epistemic status — served with a derived evidence_tier (theorem, measured, model, analogy, conditional, context, literature, open) so "only theorem-grade edges" is answerable without parsing seventy-one free-text statuses. ROUTE: the quantity bus carries a number along it. REFUSAL: the bus found the coupling admissible and DECLINED it, carrying the sentence saying why — the boundary an agent can plan around. SOURCED: a cited connection with its URLs and its claim kind. FAMILY: a QUESTION several laboratories answer in different units — an edge says two laboratories are related, a family says several are answering the same question and disagree about what the answer even is; each row names the bus key carrying its number, and the family declares whether it is one number or a relation. Filter by laboratory, kind or tier; an unknown value is refused with the known ones named.

tools.name: list_measurements
tools.description: What the atlas has measured about its own behaviour, from four artifacts generated by walking it headlessly. SENSITIVITY: 484 inputs driven one at a time — 407 respond and 25 are DEAD, meaning moving them changes no output at all, which no contract reveals and which decides whether a sweep measures anything. TRANSFERS: the exponent between an input and an output per route. REACH: 511 composed chains, each judged a power law, not a power law, or unjudged. LIVENESS: every view and whether it visibly responds to its own controls. Each artifact reports its own release stamp and whether it was measured on THIS release — one of them is deliberately dated, and a stale measurement read as a fresh one is worse than none.

tools.name: list_open_problems
tools.description: Every declared gap in the atlas, machine-readable, including the ones it carried only in prose.

statuses.EXACT: closed form, or an identity that holds to machine precision by construction
statuses.NUMERICALLY_VERIFIED: no closed form, but reproduced by an independent numerical route inside a stated tolerance
statuses.CONDITIONAL: exact GIVEN a declared assumption or ansatz that this atlas does not derive
statuses.REFERENCE_MODEL: a standard abstract model, useful as a benchmark, NOT a prediction about a physical device
statuses.SYNTHETIC_ONLY: exercised only against data this software generated; no external measurement has ever been used
statuses.OPEN: the mathematics is stated and the object does not yet exist; no number is returned
statuses.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: declared in the catalogue, no computational contract yet; returns no number at all
